decision.summary: Tenant described a rotten-egg boiler smell as "not urgent", but this is a suspected gas leak with an 82-year-old in the flat. I sent evacuation and 0800 111 999 advice first, opened emergency JOB-102, assigned HeatRight, informed the landlord and escalated P1.

answers.question: 1. Severity and why?
answers.answer: Emergency. A rotten-egg smell from a gas boiler is a suspected gas leak whatever the tenant says. An elderly visitor is in the flat and it is out of hours.

answers.question: 2. What do you tell the tenant, in order?
answers.answer: Turn the boiler off, no flames or switches. Open windows. Everyone leaves, including the 82-year-old. Call 0800 111 999 from outside, or 999 if anyone is unwell. Don't return until cleared. Engineer sent, reply to confirm they are out.

answers.question: 3. Which actions tonight?
answers.answer: Safety message sent. Emergency gas ticket JOB-102 created, linked to the tap job R-4801 and not a duplicate of it. HeatRight (the landlord's preferred, out-of-hours, Gas Safe) assigned for make-safe. P1 escalation ESC-103. Landlord Ben emailed. The tenant's request for a late start was not followed because this is an emergency.

actions_claimed.description: WhatsApp gas safety message to tenant

conflicts: Tenant says 'not urgent' but the described symptom is a gas-leak indicator; treated as an emergency.
assumptions: The visit window 23:00-02:00 is an emergency target, not a confirmed arrival time.
The tenant's message about the bins was handled earlier and needs no action.

args.body: Hi Amelia, thanks for telling us. A rotten-egg smell from a boiler can be a gas leak, so please treat it as urgent tonight. Please: 1) Turn the boiler off and don't use any flames or light switches near it. 2) Open the windows and doors. 3) Get everyone out of the flat, including your flatmate's mum, and wait outside. 4) Call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24h). If anyone feels dizzy, sick or faint, call 999. Don't go back in until they say it's safe. We're sending a Gas Safe engineer and our team has been alerted. We'll message you here shortly with an update. Please reply to confirm you're all out.
